# SparkArk
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/core-contracts/src/contracts/arks/SparkArk.sol)

**Inherits:**
[Ark](../ark.md)

**Title:**
SparkArk

Ark contract for managing token supply and yield generation through Spark Protocol (Aave V3 fork).

Implements strategy for supplying tokens, withdrawing tokens, and claiming rewards on Spark.


## State Variables
### spToken
The Spark spToken address (equivalent to aToken in Aave)


```solidity
address public immutable spToken
```


### sparkPool
The Spark pool address


```solidity
IPoolV3 public immutable sparkPool
```


### rewardsController
The Spark rewards controller address


```solidity
IRewardsController public immutable rewardsController
```


### _withdrawableTotalAssets

Internal function to get the total assets that are withdrawable

Returns 0 unless the reserve is active and not paused. A frozen
reserve is deliberately NOT treated as blocking: Spark (like Aave)
keeps withdrawals/repayments/liquidations active on frozen reserves
and only halts supplying/borrowing. When withdrawals are allowed, the
amount is capped by the underlying liquidity held by the spToken
(config.asset.balanceOf(spToken)), so it can be less than
totalAssets() when the market is highly utilised.


```solidity
function _withdrawableTotalAssets() internal view override returns (uint256 withdrawableAssets);
```
